maintenance.title: No connection to the system

foodCost.yieldNotice: Cost now includes each item's yield
foodCost.yieldNoticeBody: If a recipe calls for 200 g of peeled potato, you're charged the 222 g you had to buy. Dishes using items with a yield set show a higher cost than before — nothing broke, that factor was missing.
foodCost.historySubtitle: How the dish's price and food cost moved over time.
foodCost.unreliableBody: History started being recorded that day. For earlier dates you see the value at that moment, not what was actually in effect.
